visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men are situated in a professional studio setting with a vertical split-screen layout. The top half features two men sitting in black gaming chairs behind a white desk equipped with microphones and water bottles. A cat meme video appears as a central overlay. The man in the bottom frame wears a black sweatshirt and bobs his head side-to-side with high physical energy. (2) A second meme displays a ginger cat with squinted eyes. The man in the bottom frame imitates the expression by squinting and placing his fingers near his eyes to simulate tears. The background is a clean white studio wall with some posters. The lighting is bright and flat. (3) A third meme shows a shocked white cat. The man below mimics the wide-eyed, open-mouthed expression while yellow variety-style text overlays appear. The men in the top frame are seen laughing and gesturing towards the bottom screen. (4) A dancing cat meme is presented. The man in the bottom frame performs a rhythmic dance with his arms raised, mimicking the cat's movements. Multiple colorful graphic overlays flash on the screen. (5) The final meme shows two cats staring intensely. The man below mimics the stare directly into the camera. The men above are seen doubled over in laughter, pointing at the bottom character.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic meme music featuring the 'Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa' melody starts immediately. Female vocals sing in a high pitch. Sharp 'ding' sound effects trigger as the first meme is presented. Multiple male voices are heard laughing loudly in the background. (2) The music shifts to a rhythmic, percussive track with a heavy bass kick. A male voice speaks with high emotional arousal and excitement in Traditional Chinese. Sounds of a water bottle being opened and moved are audible. (3) A digital 'buzzer' or 'stinger' sound effect marks a transition. Loud group laughter, sounding like a live reaction, dominates the audio mix. The BGM remains upbeat with synthesized drum hits. (4) A new electronic dance track with a driving beat plays. Continuous male shouting and rapid-fire speech occur simultaneously with the music. Percussive 'hit' SFX emphasize the visual movements. (5) The audio track features rapid-fire laughter and high-frequency digital UI 'clicks'. The music swells in volume for the finale, with energetic male shouting 'Ya!' and applause-like noises before cutting off.
